loginPage.title: Log in

loginPage.expired: Your session ended. Log in again.

errors.generic: We could not log you in

business.typeHint: For example: Food · Lunch menus, Grocery, Beauty.

location.intro: Write the address and mark the point on the map. Your customers see the distance from that location.
location.addressInvalid: Add street and number, or mark the point on the map.
location.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the marker to your store's door.

errors.location: We could not place your store
errors.email: An account with this email already exists

errors.generic: We could not register your business

created.title: Campaign published
created.description: Customers inside the zone you chose can already see it.

empty.title: Publish an offer for your area
